assessment: K7 names the principal kernel/systemd/compatibility premises and explicitly requires redesign, no exception and no finite-probe substitution. None is installed evidence. L1 and PTRACE-GID probe coverage is incomplete; COPY/BUS/ROOTS cannot be assumed over the full original domain from a finite fixture; EXCH effects must be composed; and a common-instant/completeness bridge for SCAN-R/GATE/W and Q1-Q8 is missing. No premise is accepted by this review. Generic manual support is distinguished from installed-host proof.

premises.remaining: The K7 statement includes io_uring-registered writable descriptions, but the specified probe rows test live descriptors, SCM_RIGHTS queues and mappings without an explicit registered-description case. Installed-version kernel/filesystem evidence remains required.
The permission/ACL/hardlink argument is conditional on installed kernel and all accepted source filesystems. Device equality is not an exact no-mount predicate.

Add process_vm_writev and distinguish REALCREDS/FSCREDS and allowed versus denied control access under Yama and dumpability. Generic documentation supports an external-caller prerequisite, not a host proof or unqualified statement about all accesses.
The explicit exchange primitive is conditionally suitable. Include parent entry-set/timestamp and moved-root metadata effects, and every partial exchange state, not only destination references.

No blanket compatibility assumption may exclude accepted foreign owners or mounted filesystems. Specify the group-setting/readback operation, exact attribute sequencing, successful data-read and SEEK behavior, directory atime, and failure preservation. O_NOATIME does not cover foreign-owned sources.
Exact installed filter/kernel architecture and exhaustive interface coverage require source-matched evidence; legitimate original target calls cannot be excluded by assumption.
Manager/delegation/inheritance/compatibility are hypotheses; no current host setup or successful tests were used in this review.
A finite probe cannot establish that no other interface confers initial-namespace identities/capabilities. Require exhaustive source-grounded coverage of the installed interface and implementation.

The absorption argument is conditional on all Q predicates holding at a common moment. Sequential whole-population/manager/descriptor scans and equal snapshots do not specify how they establish that common state under churn. Source evidence for S4/S5 is especially material.
PAM-less runtime-directory/delegation and manager compatibility stay open; failure requires redesign.
A successful fixed run cannot establish that every original accepted allowlisted action never needs the bus. Preserve the accepted case or keep the obligation open.
The proposed non-replaceable roots must not turn possible root lifecycle behavior into a new restriction or change deterministic fixtures.
May redesign or omit this optional branch while preserving the original task. Root code/rule/source review and existing operator authorization remain mandatory.
If it fails, no allocation-failure durability claim; this is not permission to delete the original durability requirement.

premises.probe: sacrificial measured geometry and compatible execution controls
premises.remaining: Noexec or finite image geometry must not stand in for the native execution/capacity controls or add an accepted size cap.
Search-only known-name lookup can check named files but not the exact complete entry set. Restore the sealed per-use requirement without adding a new operator gate.
